elements.evidence: Section 13 as rendered still binds both parties ("Neither party shall ... solicit for hire ... any of the other party's personnel"), so Clear Capital (Company/Customer) remains subject to a non-solicit. The redline narrows rather than deletes the covenant, so the preferred position is not reached.
Operative text opens "Neither party shall ... solicit ... any of the other party's personnel", which binds Company and Contractor symmetrically; this was already present and correctly left unchanged.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Scope is limited to "any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services" — no coverage of all personnel; retained verbatim from p0047.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The temporal anchor was re-cut from "during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination" to "for one (1) year after the end of such personnel's involvement with the Services". One (1) year equals 12 months and runs from the end of involvement, exactly the fallback anchor. The deterministic check reporting "number not found" is a numeral-matching artefact (the period is spelled "one (1) year", not "12 months"); inspected in substance, the duration and anchor conform.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Added sentence: "The foregoing restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other general solicitations not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel...".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Same added sentence continues "...or to unsolicited approaches by such personnel."

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The prohibition is on the act of solicitation ("solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise"); there is no free-standing bar on employing or engaging personnel who are not solicited, and the added unsolicited-approach carve-out reinforces that hiring per se is not prohibited. No no-hire language exists elsewhere in the cited clause.
No conditional elements in this checklist; all six fallback elements were assessed directly against the rendered clause.

reasons: The rendered clause meets all six fallback elements, so the redline is position-complete at the fallback level; the preferred (no restriction on Customer) is not reached, which is acceptable because the finding targets the fallback.

Duration element verified in substance despite the failing regex: "one (1) year after the end of such personnel's involvement with the Services" is a 12-month period anchored to the end of involvement, precisely the fallback formulation. The regex looked for a numeral threshold and missed the spelled-out period.

Minimality holds: only two operations were made — re-anchoring the temporal phrase and inserting a single carve-out sentence covering both required exclusions. Favourable retained language (mutuality, direct-involvement scope, the consent-not-unreasonably-withheld softener) is preserved verbatim, and no survival tail, expense language, procedure or other extra was added.

Intent preserved: no defined term is orphaned ("Services" remains defined in Section 1(a)), no cross-reference dangles, and no retained sentence contradicts the new carve-out. The narrowing of the period so that it starts when involvement ends is the exact fallback anchor and operates mutually, so it does not create a one-sided allocation shift.
No walk-away trigger is present: the covenant is solicitation-only, under 24 months, and does not reach all Vendor personnel.
